messages:
jamie: ping - tenant 'stellar-sync' reporting spikes of 429s every minute since 08:00 UTC
tina: do we have a sample from their client logs? streaming or poll-type requests?
jamie: they sent a snippet - looks aligned to minute ticks:
```
2026-03-17T08:00:00Z POST /v1/sync 200 34ms
2026-03-17T08:00:00Z POST /v1/sync 429 "rate_limit_exceeded"
2026-03-17T08:00:01Z POST /v1/sync 429
```
marcel: pulling tenant counters now. infra-bot, give me 07:59-08:01 for tenant=stellar-sync
infra-bot: `GET /admin/tenants/stellar-sync/limits?window=2m` ->
``
infra-bot: tenant=stellar-sync window=120s rpm=820 tpm=49200 limit_rpm=500 limit_tpm=100000 rule=tenant_rpm
```
jamie: rpm 820 vs limit 500. minute folding from ~300 edge devices polling all at :00
tina: mitigation options: jitter clients, temporary grace queue (smoothing), or emergency RPM increase if billing allows
marcel: customer asked for a non-UX breaking option. we can enable a soft grace queue per-tenant that will buffer for up to 30s. admin call is:
``
PATCH /admin/tenants/stellar-sync/actions
{
  "action": "enable_smoothing",
  "params": { "backlog_seconds": 30 },
  "note": "temporary smoothing for minute-boundary poll surge"
}
```
jamie: note to support: smoothing reduces 429s but introduces tail latency. confirm customer OK
tina: customer approved 3-hour smoothing window while they roll out jitter. please enable now
marcel: enabled smoothing at 08:12 UTC. infra-bot confirms:
infra-bot: [08:14:00 UTC] tenant=stellar-sync window=60s rpm=515 tpm=30600 rate_limit_status=soft_smoothing
jamie: good - rpm under hard limit but still elevated; observed additional ~150-500ms on some requests
tina: sent customer recommended client changes: uniform jitter in [0,60s] for sync and randomized retry with exponential backoff (base=500ms, cap=5s)
jamie: included sample code in the message and a note about avoiding immediate retries after 429s
marcel: follow-ups:
- product: surface minute-boundary spike chart in tenant console (prod ticket opened)
- engineering: add an alert when tenant RPM crosses 80% of limit for 3 consecutive minute ticks
- support: doc snippet for customers: how to safely add jitter and backoff
- billing: prepared optional short RPM bump if customer needs capacity after smoothing window
support-bot: ticket-78102 updated with admin action and logs
jamie: leaving ticket open until we have 180 minutes of stability or they confirm rollout complete
tina: small ops note: if customers use synchronized cron-based polling, recommend server-side webhooks where possible to avoid polling bursts
marcel: agreed. also documenting in runbook the admin flags and UX tradeoffs for smoothing
jamie: thanks team, closing once monitoring shows 4 consecutive 5-minute windows under threshold :thumbsup:
